        min_c = min(p[1] for p in comp)
        norm = frozenset((p[0] - min_r, p[1] - min_c) for p in comp)
        color_shape_count[color] += 1
    
    for norm, items in shape_groups.items():
        colors = {c for c, _ in items}
        
        # Find the "source" color - the one that has this as its ONLY shape
        source_color = None
        for color in colors:
            if color_shape_count[color] == 1:
                source_color = color
                break
        
        # If no source found, use the color that appears first in reading order
        if source_color is None:
            items_sorted = sorted(items, key=lambda item: min(p for p in item[1]))
            source_color = items_sorted[0][0]
        
        # Recolor all components that are NOT the source color
        for color, comp in items:
            if color != source_color:
                for r, c in comp:
                    result[r][c] = source_color
